description: A dark, low-key oil painting of a laboratory bench. A dark-gloved hand pours a pale yellow liquid from a small glass vessel into a clear glass bottle holding dark red-brown liquid. Behind them are a glass flask, a brass fitting, and a wooden rack of test tubes with small paper labels that carry faint marks. The table is wooden, the setting is a 19th-century-style laboratory, and the painting fills the frame edge to edge.
reason: Shows a chemistry lab with a gloved hand pouring liquid into a bottle, not an aircraft; the card is the Junkers J1 all-metal plane, so the art needs an aircraft. The test-tube labels also carry handwriting-like marks, which must not appear.
